I look at this very nice graph @NewLeftEViews and ask myself, what exactly are we arguing about? The upturn in the export demand share of Chinese manuf value added 2020-2025, from 24 to 27% ? That is what the kerfuffle is about?


New Left EViews (@NewLeftEViews)

The OECD's TiVA data are cool. And there's an argument that export data overstate China's external dependence. But the conclusion here is not supported.

It's worth looking more closely: they do a lot to clarify different narratives ab
